security.title: Security
security.lead: We take the security of EZAuth and the data we hold for our users very seriously. This page describes how to report a vulnerability, what is in scope, and how we coordinate disclosure.
security.contactBody: Please email security@ezstart.dev with a clear description of the issue, the steps required to reproduce it, and any proof-of-concept material. We acknowledge new reports within two business days. A PGP key for encrypted reports will be published here once finalized.
security.scopeBody: All production EZAuth domains are in scope, including ezauth.ezstart.xyz and the api.ezauth.ezstart.xyz API. Out of scope: denial-of-service, social engineering, physical attacks, and findings that require already-compromised credentials.
security.disclosureBody: We follow a coordinated disclosure model: please give us a reasonable window to investigate and ship a fix before going public. We are happy to credit researchers in our changelog when a fix ships, unless you prefer to remain anonymous.
